title: CEB: COMPOSITIONAL EVALUATION BENCHMARK FOR FAIRNESS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through a 5-task taxonomy: direct evaluation via bias recognition and selection tasks (measured by Micro-F1), and indirect evaluation via text continuation and conversation tasks (scored by GPT-4 for stereotyping and Perspective API for toxicity), as well as binary classification tasks (measured by Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, and Unfairness Score).
